headline: Renault to Create 2,000 Factory Jobs While Eliminating 1,000 Administrative Roles
summary: French automaker Renault announced a workforce restructuring plan to add 2,000 production jobs in France by 2028 while cutting 1,000 administrative roles to boost competitiveness against Chinese EV makers.
why: Renault is one of Europe's largest automobile manufacturers, adjusting manufacturing footprint for electric vehicle transition costs.

impacts.name: Renault
impacts.why: Shift toward lean operational staffing improves manufacturing margins against low-cost import competitors.
